decisive_items: Viral cytopathic inclusions (highlighted by CMV immunostain)
multiple, punched-out, irregular, nonbleeding ulcers in the rectum
response.rationale: The vignette describes a patient with rectal ulcers and histopathology showing viral cytopathic inclusions highlighted by CMV immunostain, which is diagnostic of cytomegalovirus colitis. R1 is the most specific and accurate label.

rejected.why: Diverticulitis is not supported; the findings are not diverticular and CMV inclusions are present.
Ischemic colitis is not supported; no ischemic features and CMV inclusions are present.
Radiation proctitis is not supported; there is no radiation history and CMV inclusions are present.
Inflammatory bowel disease is not the best diagnosis because CMV immunostain is positive and viral cytopathic changes are present.
This is a non-preferred completion of the same diagnosis; R1 is the canonical label.
Gastrointestinal bleeding is a symptom, not the most likely diagnosis; CMV colitis is the underlying cause.
